mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a 0.5% FEDFUNDS increase, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances following a 3-month RSAFS increase, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which often precedes a broader economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances following a 0.5% UNRATE increase, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are adversely affected.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances following a 2% INDPRO decrease, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases > 0.3% and PAYEMS decreases > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances following the joint trigger, or if Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2%) combined with a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) suggests a policy misstep, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances following the joint trigger, or if Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of a decline in GDP (GDPC1) and an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a shift towards capital-intensive production, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors favor capital goods sectors.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases > 1% and INDPRO increases > 1% over 3 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances following the joint trigger, or if Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
